subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should `deferred` become a permanent public cron, gateway, plugin-hook, CLI, Control UI, and SDK status, or remain an internal yielded-parent lifecycle state?
rationale: The runtime defect is mechanically repairable, but source inspection cannot determine whether OpenClaw wants to expand its persisted and public status contract across these surfaces.

options.title: Adopt public deferred status
options.body: Keep the new value across all surfaces, with explicit compatibility documentation and fresh-install plus upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Keep waiting internal
options.body: Preserve existing public status unions and expose yielded waiting through internal lifecycle state and diagnostics instead.

recommendation.title: Adopt public deferred status
recommendation.body: Keep the new value across all surfaces, with explicit compatibility documentation and fresh-install plus upgrade proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person to both isolated-cron delivery and Discord subagent lifecycle, the principal surfaces in this decision.
